executive_summary: The team discussed using meeting intelligence to turn leadership conversations into review-ready materials while keeping people in the approval loop. The pilot should focus on measurable time savings, better operational prioritization, and traceable recommendations.

objectives.objective: Reduce manual effort spent converting meetings into leadership materials.
Improve prioritization by grounding operational insights in source evidence.
Pilot meeting intelligence before expanding into customer-facing automation.

evidence.source_text: [00:00] Maya, COO: We spend too much time every Friday turning meeting notes into leadership updates. I want the pilot to show whether AI can reduce that manual reporting effort without lowering quality.

action_items.action: Run a pilot using recent leadership and operations meeting transcripts.
action_items.business_rationale: Historical meetings can validate summary quality and review effort before production use.

action_items.action: Define review criteria for accuracy, evidence quality, cost, and time savings.
action_items.business_rationale: The pilot needs measurable acceptance criteria before broader distribution.

action_items.action: Keep human approval mandatory before any generated material is shared.
action_items.business_rationale: Human review controls risk when recommendations are generated from imperfect transcripts.

evidence.source_text: [00:00] Maya, COO: We spend too much time every Friday turning meeting notes into leadership updates. I want the pilot to show whether AI can reduce that manual reporting effort without lowering quality.

next_steps.step: Collect candidate meeting transcripts for the pilot batch.
Review generated summaries and decks with leadership stakeholders.
Compare manual prep time against automated output and revision time.

risks_and_uncertainties: Transcript quality may limit the accuracy of extracted decisions and owners.
Owners and due dates should remain null unless stated clearly in the source meeting.
Broader automation should wait until reviewers trust the evidence trail.
